metadata.title: कालीबाई कालासुआ की कहानी | Story of brave Bhil girl Kalibai Kalasua | Tribal Heroes
metadata.description: Kalibai Kalasua, often hailed as the "Goddess of Literacy" and a symbol of modern-day Eklavya, resided in the enchanting Dungarpur district of Rajasthan. Her profound sacrifice in defense of her teacher against British colonial forces ignited a fervor among the Rajasthani populace, leaving an indelible mark on the region's history and inspiring a wave of enthusiasm for learning and education.
